name: engineering-rules
description: The complete engineering law and working method as one progressive-disclosure skill: hard caps and zero-tolerance bans, the file and folder organization law, performance/security/test-scenario catalogs, an eight-phase workflow driven by a phase ledger that refuses to advance without its exit artifact, a run discipline (task start, phase boundaries, loop-backs, waiver limits, git safety, a law self-audit), six question banks, five review checks, the ship gate, and twelve ready-made design specs. 106 sections, loaded only when the phase calls for them.
